description: 국가철도공단 대구2호선 출구별 주요장소 [railways and stations] (series on Public Data Portal (data.go.kr)) is a series of datasets listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 지하철 역의 출구 번호에 대한 주요건물(관공서, 학교, 병원, 종교시설, 아파트, 공원 등)시설 정보 등이 포함되어 있습니다. 지하철 출구번호는 어떻게 매겨질까요? 1. Coverage: South Korea. The portal lists 8 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 주요장소, 지하철, 대구지하철, 출구장소, 출구번호. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
